Benefits of Styrofoam Recycling

  • Reduces the amount of solid waste sent to landfills and incinerators.
  • Increases economic security by tapping a domestic source of materials.
  • Reduces our dependency on virgin resources and conserves them for future generations.
  • Prevents pollution by reducing the need to collect new raw materials.
  • Saves energy that would otherwise be expended on manufacturing new materials.
  • Supports American manufacturing and conserves valuable resources.
  • Helps create jobs in the recycling and manufacturing industries in the United States.

Styrofoam...

100% Recyclable

Not many people know that styrofoam is 100% recyclable. Clean material can be reused in the manufacturing process of new products in the market. Any slightly contaminated material can be compacted and turned into recycled rigid plastic products

98% Air

Expanded polystyrene (EPS) foam, commonly known as styrofoam, is the lightweight material used in packaging electronic devices, food items and electric appliances are popularly used because of their water and heat resistant properties

ODP of Zero

Styrofoam has an Ozone Depletion Potential (ODP) of zero and causes no damage to the ozone layer because no CFCs or HCFCs are used during the manufacturing process. Styrofoam is inert, does not leach any chemicals, and is completely food contact safe.
